content: Multi-tenant readiness: three DB tenancy patterns are shared-schema, schema-per-tenant, database-per-tenant, with hybrid emerging (pooled standard tier + isolated enterprise tier). Bridge tenancy is the recommended default for small teams: start pooled/shared-schema with a tenant_id column on every row scoped via app-layer middleware, then silo DB/jobs per-tenant later for premium/compliance customers. Retrofitting multi-tenancy after building single-tenant-only is a hard, multi-month migration if the tenant boundary was never modeled in the schema from day one.
